title: Aman Tavern
summary: Choose and exchange the Aman abilities available at AB40, AB50, and AB60.

title: Ascending
summary: Exchange experience for permanent health or mana after qualifying for ascension.

title: Buying Stats
summary: Masters can exchange spare health for stat points at 150 HP per point.

title: Druid Forms
summary: Compare Feral, Komodas, and Karura before selecting a Druid form.

title: Experience Gem
summary: Use Experience Gem to buy health or mana without visiting the ascension temples.

title: Experience Hunting
summary: Use hunting experience for levels and, after level 99, permanent character growth.

title: Generic stat plans
summary: Use class and ability requirements to plan a character without importing anyone’s personal stats. The order of Constitution and Wisdom investment affects growth while leveling.

title: Hunting for ability points
summary: Medenian advancement uses ability points to unlock equipment and higher ability ranks.

title: Learn Skill/Spell Trinket
summary: Use the Learn Skill/Spell Trinket for eligible abilities from a previous class.

title: Learning Spell
summary: Learn many Medenian abilities by entering their exact names into Learning Spell.

title: Legendary Aisling
summary: Claim Legendary Aisling after mastery and sufficient character age.

title: Mastery
summary: Mastery opens the next equipment and ability tier at insight 99. Choose whether to subpath first: becoming a Master makes that choice permanent.

title: Medenian advancement
summary: After the four Creants, advance within your main class along its Medenian path and begin earning ability levels. Ability level, insight level, and individual skill ranks are separate systems.

title: Meditation List
summary: Find the meditation response required for a Dugon color.

title: Monk Forms
summary: Compare the stat changes and signature abilities of four Monk forms.

title: Monk Skills & Spells
summary: Trace Monk ability prerequisites and required learned levels.

title: Necromancy
summary: Wizards can enter the necromantic order and summon temporary undead.

title: Priest Spells
summary: Trace Priest spell dependencies and minimum trained spell levels.

title: Rogue Skills & Spells
summary: Trace Rogue skill dependencies and required training levels.

title: Sapphire Stream
summary: Earn Dugon training through eligibility, a timed hunt, and meditation.

title: Subbing Process
summary: Prepare the ascension prerequisite and materials before beginning the subpath ceremony.

title: Subpathing
summary: Subpathing is an optional choice at insight 99, before mastery. Change your class to combine abilities learned in two paths, or remain on a pure path and proceed directly to mastery. The decision resets your level and changes which pure-only abilities remain available.

title: The four Creants
summary: Defeat Tauren, Lady Phoenix, Medusa, and Shamensyth to earn all four marks required for Medenian advancement. “Grandmaster” describes this stage of progression rather than a separate class.

title: Warrior Skills & Spells
summary: Trace Warrior skill dependencies and minimum training levels.

title: Wizard Skills & Spells
summary: Trace elemental Wizard spell prerequisites using the fire sequence as an example.

title: Monk · Druid
summary: Druid is the Medenian path within Monk. Combat forms and form-specific abilities.

title: Priest · Bard
summary: Bard is the Medenian path within Priest. Healing, support, and musical abilities.

title: Rogue · Archer
summary: Archer is the Medenian path within Rogue. Ranged attacks and specialized bows.

title: Warrior · Gladiator
summary: Gladiator is the Medenian path within Warrior. Weapon skills and close-range combat.

title: Wizard · Summoner
summary: Summoner is the Medenian path within Wizard. Elemental magic and mana-based abilities.
